messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall - kv-prefetch error spike in prod detected (5xxs and increased tail latency). Auto-alert tripped: alert://grafana/alerts/7890. Please ack.
oncall-ana: Acked. Looking now. Seeing prefetched read failures and a lot of cache bypasses hitting upstream DB.
devon: Adding context — we're seeing a sudden increase in tenant-cardinality for prefetched keys, causing prefetch worker queue buildup and massive downstream read fanout.
oncall-ana: Confirmed. Error breakdown: 70% prefetched reads timeout, 20% upstream 503, rest connection resets.
suresh: Do we have a particular tenant hotkeying this?
oncall-ana: Quick grep shows handful of tenants with heavy prefetch requests. Top offender: tenant-acme-corp (10x normal).
customer-success-jess: I'm pulling recent customer tickets for Acme, triage in progress.
devon: Mitigation idea: temporarily disable prefetch jobs for the high-cardinality prefix namespace and apply conservative per-tenant read rate-limit. Should be low-risk for correctness.
oncall-ana: Agreed — prefer disabling prefetch for the affected prefix then shaping traffic. I'll run a scoped toggle.
oncall-ana: infra-bot, run: `prefetchctl disable --namespace prefix:acct-* --reason "live mitigation - error spike" --dry-run=false`
infra-bot: command accepted, executing. Affected workers will get rolling update (max 2 at a time).
infra-bot: Done. Prefetch disabled for prefixes matching `prefix:acct-*`. Rolling take 90s.
devon: Next: throttle read fanout for tenant-acme-corp at the edge. On RB proxy add a token bucket: `rps: 5` with burst 10.
oncall-ana: Patch applied to 2 regions, canary looks fine. No increased 5xx from clients.
suresh: Also propose a temporary KV cache bypass for correctness for any keys with prefetch failures so we avoid stale reads? That could increase DB load though.
devon: We should prefer cache-bypass only for correctness-critical ops; otherwise we rely on read-through with backoff.
oncall-ana: Okay — enabling safe-bypass policy for critical routes only: `/v1/generate` and `/v1/embeddings` with tenant whitelist.
oncall-ana: infra-bot, run: `kvctl set-bypass --routes /v1/generate,/v1/embeddings --tenants tenant-acme-corp --ttl 15m --note "safe-bypass during prefetch outage"`
infra-bot: Applied. Routes for tenant-acme-corp now bypass prefetch cache (ttl 15m). Monitor DB QPS.
devon: Observability note: enabling bypass increased DB QPS for acme from 120 -> 420 QPS. We need quota adjustments or fallbacks.
oncall-ana: Temporarily increase DB quota for that tenant from 1 unit -> 3 units.
oncall-ana: pagerduty-bot, set oncall-slo to degraded and notify infra-oncall-signal.
pagerduty-bot: SLO status set to "degraded". PagerDuty alert group notified.
customer-success-jess: I've messaged Acme support with a short note: "We're seeing elevated errors affecting some prefetch operations; workarounds in place, no data loss expected. We'll update in 30m."
suresh: We should also apply a short per-tenant hard quota to prevent repeat spikes. Suggest: limit prefetch queue submissions to 50/min for customers not on enterprise.
devon: I pushed a quick config to rate-limit prefetch submissions by tenant-tier.
devon: Config snippet: ```
prefetch_rate_limits:
  enterprise: 500/min
  standard: 50/min
  trial: 20/min
```
oncall-ana: Rolling out now. Patch will converge in ~2m.
infra-bot: Rate-limit config accepted and rolled to edge proxies.
devon: Watching metrics — prefetch queue depth dropping, total 5xxs falling. Latency improved from p99 2.4s -> 1.1s.
oncall-ana: Good. Next steps: continue monitoring 15m, prepare handoff to second oncall, and start a short RCA note.
suresh: For postmortem I'll capture root cause: unbounded prefetch fanout + tenant-level traffic spike + lack of hard per-tenant throttles. Also include why bypass for correctness was used.
customer-success-jess: I'll follow up with Acme after 30m with a detailed status and ETA.
oncall-ana: Handoff: I'll be oncall for another 20m then handing to devon. Devon, accept?
devon: Accepting. I'll keep watching until metrics fully normalized.
oncall-ana: Final checklist executed: disabled prefetch for prefix:acct-*, applied per-tenant rate-limits, enabled safe bypass for critical routes for affected tenant, raised DB quota temporarily, notified customer, set SLO degraded.
oncall-ana: Marking incident as mitigated but not resolved. Please add any notes, I'll open followup ticket: INF-2314 (prefetch safeguards & quota automation).
suresh: Adding action: implement automated circuit breaker when prefetch queue depth > 80% and auto-apply per-tenant backpressure.
devon: Also add better telemetry: per-tenant prefetch fanout histograms and early-warning alerts.
customer-success-jess: Acme acknowledged, appreciates the proactive note.
oncall-ana: Handing over to devon now. Leaving this thread in case anything flares. :white_check_mark:
